title: 第30章 答应直播
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
王景焕带了一支他家爷爷强烈要求他送过来的毛笔，据说是明万历竹刻花鸟纹毛笔。

    老爷子花了一百多万拍卖回来一直收藏着，没想到也舍得送出去。

    想到送的人是谁，王景焕也觉得值得。

    王景焕过来后第一时间便拜访了郁凡，将自家老爷子的心意先一步送给了郁凡。

    郁凡收到王老的礼物有些惊讶，这段时间自家儿子天天跟着王老学习，回家来还跟自己说王老爷子教的很用心，他学到了不少。

    自己还没有谢谢他，没想到他却送来礼物了。

    “郁神医，我爷爷说您送的那幅画，他非常喜欢，这是回礼。”

    郁凡这才想起来之前去饭店的时候随手让郁嘉庆送过去的礼物。

    原来如此，发现了画中的好处了？

    那幅字可不仅仅只是普通一个有着神韵的字，挂在墙头没事看看还能让人心平气和。

    除了改善心境，这其中暗含的灵气对于所处空间的人身体更是有好处。

    这王老头子，没想到这么早便能意识到了。

    郁凡表示知道后，直接让王景焕去找郁颜了。

    他还不至于眼瞎看不出来王景焕对于自己孙女的好感。

    虽然王景焕在海市算的上是一个成功的商人，但在他看来还是太过于普通，除了商业方面，他倒是没有看出什么其他特别的地方。

    但他也没想过阻止他们两人，如果两人之间互相有好感，何必去阻止呢？

    而且谁也没有规定谈恋爱就一定会结婚，自己的孙女，怎么也不会让她受欺负。

    王景焕此次前来自然是为了热搜的事情，目前的郁颜没有什么拿得出手的作品，曝光率不够。

    虽然最近段时间用公司的资源给郁颜拉了一个剧组的角色，可毕竟是个小配角，戏份并不多。

    而且影视剧真的拍完上映也需要时间，那这段时间的郁颜又该怎么办？

    没有粉丝基础的新人在这个圈子里可是很难混的开的。

    王景焕也有想过让郁颜去参加一些选秀节目。

    偏偏前段时间一个选秀节目出了丑闻，广电局对于这类型的节目都控制得极其严格，几乎阉割了所有的选秀节目。

    但这次的直播给了他不少的想法，或许粉丝不一定非要作品才能拥有。

    虎鱼知道郁颜是他公司艺人，已经联系过他了。

    他和虎鱼的老板是好友，已经为郁颜重新准备了S级主播签约合同。

    这正是他所需要的，平台不会干涉郁颜的直播，且只拿1%，这已经算是没有收取多少打赏费用了，但这个前提的条件是郁颜的直播只能在虎鱼平台进行。

    王景焕将S级合同的事情告诉给郁颜，就看她怎么去选择了。

    郁颜没想到自己运气这么好，就是一个直播，却惊动了虎鱼的高层。

    她差点高兴的跳起来。

    “这是真实存在的吗？我简直不敢置信。”

    王景焕笑着看郁颜高兴的容颜，真心为她开心。

    “放心，合同的事情，我认真的看过，而且我和虎鱼的老板是好兄弟，想必他也不敢搞什么阴阳合同。”
content_en:
Wang Jinghuan brought a brush that his grandfather strongly requested him to send. It is said to be a bamboo-carved flower-and-bird pattern brush from Wanli in the Ming Dynasty.

The old man spent more than one million yuan on the auction and has been collecting it ever since. Unexpectedly, he was willing to give it away.

When he thought about who the gift was, Wang Jinghuan felt it was worth it.

Wang Jinghuan visited Yu Fan as soon as he came over, and sent his old man's feelings to Yu Fan in advance.

Yu Fan was a little surprised when he received Mr. Wang's gift. During this period, his son studied with Mr. Wang every day. When he came home, he told himself that Mr. Wang taught carefully and he learned a lot.

I haven't thanked him yet, but unexpectedly he sent me a gift.

"Doctor Yu, my grandfather said that he likes the painting you gave me very much. This is a return gift."

Only then did Yu Fan remember the gift he had asked Yu Jiaqing to give when he went to the hotel.

So that’s it, have you discovered the benefit of the painting?

That calligraphy is not just an ordinary calligraphy with charm. Hanging it on the wall and looking at it can make people feel calm.

In addition to improving the state of mind, the aura contained in it is also beneficial to the body of the person in the space.

Old man Wang didn't expect to realize it so early.

After Yu Fan expressed his knowledge, he directly asked Wang Jinghuan to go find Yu Yan.

He is not so blind that he cannot see Wang Jinghuan's affection for his granddaughter.

Although Wang Jinghuan was considered a successful businessman in Haishi, he still thought he was too ordinary. Apart from the business aspect, he didn't see anything special about him.

But he never thought of stopping the two of them. If the two of them liked each other, why bother to stop them?

And no one stipulates that if you fall in love, you will definitely get married. My granddaughter will never let her be bullied.

Wang Jinghuan came here this time naturally because of the hotly searched things. Currently, Yu Yan doesn't have any good works, and the exposure rate is not enough.

Although the company's resources have recently been used to give Yu Yan a role in the crew, after all, it is a small supporting role and she does not have many roles.

Moreover, it will take time for the film and television series to be filmed and released, so what should Yu Yan do during this time?

It is difficult for newcomers without a fan base to get along in this circle.

Wang Jinghuan also thought about asking Yu Yan to participate in some talent shows.

It happened that a scandal occurred in a talent show some time ago. The Radio, Film and Television Bureau has extremely strict control over this type of programs, and has almost neutered all talent shows.

But this live broadcast gave him a lot of ideas. Maybe fans don’t necessarily need works to have them.

Huyu knew that Yu Yan was an artist in his company and had already contacted him.

He is good friends with Huyu's boss and has already prepared a new S-level anchor contract for Yu Yan.

This is exactly what he needs. The platform will not interfere with Yu Yan's live broadcast and only takes 1%. This is not a lot of reward fees, but the premise is that Yu Yan's live broadcast can only be carried out on the Huyu platform.

Wang Jinghuan told Yu Yan about the S-class contract, and it was up to her to choose.

Yu Yan didn't expect that he was so lucky that just a live broadcast would alarm the senior management of Huyu.

She almost jumped for joy.

"Is this real? I can't believe it."

Wang Jinghuan smiled at Yu Yan's happy face and was really happy for her.

"Don't worry, I've read the contract carefully, and Huyu's boss and I are good brothers. I guess he wouldn't dare to engage in any yin-yang contract."
